findings.current: Jin Taekyung watched the blue circle, the veil of mystery around the man, finally reach its target.
findings.defect: The apposition makes the blue circle the veil rather than the means of lifting it.
findings.rationale: The Korean says the blue circle will remove the veil surrounding the man.
findings.replacement: He clearly saw the blue circle that would lift the veil of mystery around the man finally reach its target.
findings.source: 그리고 그를 둘러싸고 있는 비밀의 장막을 걷어 줄 푸른 원이, 마침내 목표에 닿는 것을 똑똑히 목격할 수 있었다.

findings.current: the blue circle of [Qi Sense], which had reached Level 9, shot outward.
findings.defect: The draft turns a nine-star Skill progression into a Level.
findings.replacement: the blue circle of [Qi Sense], which had reached nine stars, shot outward.
findings.source: 어느덧 9성에 도달한 [기감]의 푸른 원이 빠르게 뻗어 나갔다.

findings.defect: The System panel retains square brackets around the Skill name, contrary to the packet’s panel-format rule.
findings.rationale: The System heading and blockquote already identify the notice; the binding rule excludes square brackets around UI terms in panels.
findings.replacement:
> **System**
> Skill Qi Sense was half successful!

findings.defect: Sooni is a different name; the source says Jeomsuni.
findings.rationale: 점순이 includes 점, which the draft drops.

findings.current: “His name changes every time I visit. There were times it was Gaettong or Sso-Ttong.”
findings.defect: Sso-Ttong misrenders 소똥이, and leaving both names unexplained hides their shared poop-name joke.
findings.rationale: 개똥 and 소똥 mean dog poop and cow poop; the paired meanings account for the absurdity of the names.
findings.replacement: “His name changes every time I visit. He’s even gone by Gaettong—Dog Poop—and Sottong—Cow Poop.”
findings.source: “갈 때마다 이름이 바뀝디다. 개똥이, 소똥이였던 적도 있소.”

summary: The draft changes how Qi Sense is described at a key moment and substitutes one of Great Sir’s claimed names. It also obscures the joke in two other names.
